instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive buttons, inputs, tabs, and navigation links feature explicit data-testid attributes formatted in kebab-case.
Do NOT use pure white or generic template backgrounds. Use rich deep maroon (#3B0014) mixed with midnight charcoal (#0D080B) and warm cream (#FAF7F2).
Combine bold sans typography (Inter) with decorative serif headlines ('Instrument Serif') for high emotional impact.
Implement the 10-step contact form cleanly with clear progress indicators, multi-select tags, and instant feedback states.
Include responsive fallback controls for touch devices where hover interactions are limited.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and grain textures.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters where appropriate.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Do NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }). Keep natural reading hierarchy.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes.
